Generate comprehensive audit reports analyzing command execution metrics.

This command analyzes command metrics to identify:
  - Commands with high failure rates
  - Frequent timeouts
  - Slow commands
  - Improvement opportunities
  - Churn indicators (user confusion patterns)

The report helps identify areas for improvement and clarifications to reduce
churn.

  Generate audit report
  zqk system audit-report
  Save report to file
  zqk system audit-report --output report.md
  Generate report with specific focus
  zqk system audit-report --focus failures

Usage:
  zqk system audit-report [flags]

Flags:
      --columns string          Override column widths for table output (format: field:width)
      --focus string            Focus on a report section: failures, timeouts, slow, churn, or all (default "all")
  -f, --format string           Output format (table, json, jsonl, yaml, csv, json-rpc, stream, agent-prompt, semantic-link) (default "table")
      --ignore-scheduler-down   Ignore scheduler down warning/lockdown
  -o, --output string           Write output to file
  -q, --quiet                   Suppress non-essential output
      --timeout duration        Timeout for command execution (0 = auto-calculate)
  -v, --verbose                 Verbose output

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
